title: Invalidation Record
description: Contradiction-mining structured landing artifact (absorption wave 1; Graphiti bi-temporal invalidate-don't-delete pattern). When evidence_deep's contradiction mining finds that a vault claim is contradicted/superseded by newer evidence, it emits THIS record as the machine-side proposal: which claim, invalidated by what, since when, on what basis. It reaches the vault ONLY via /promote-to-vault (the director reviews and the promote gate applies the bi-temporal fields to the claim page — the claim is never deleted, it is invalidated with provenance). Slugs must be real vault slugs (evidence-contract: never invent a slug).

claim_slug.description: The vault claim page being invalidated (existing slug, never invented).

invalidated_by_slug.description: The vault page (paper/result/claim) that contradicts or supersedes it.

edge_type.description: Typed edge (Graphiti absorption): refutes = direct contradiction; supersedes = newer result replaces it.

invalid_at.description: When the claim stopped holding (ISO date or the superseding work's publication date) — bi-temporal validity, caller-supplied.

basis.description: The concrete contradiction evidence (what the newer source reports vs what the claim asserts).
